title: Partner cannot survive the alliance horizon including the exit tail
thresholds_source: docs/decisions/2026-08-24-evidence-source-backlog-disposition.md (round 4) + ADR-0060 row wording; surfaces via migration 0031 — threshold by criterion wording (ADR-0060)
notes: Design section A.4 [rbd 2.2]: partner financial distress such that the partner cannot survive the alliance horizon INCLUDING the exit tail (post-exit obligations, wind-down costs). Declared in YAML, not yet executable — predicate null by design until the thresholds meeting (ADR-0052 open questions; activation convention per ADR-0057). Classification (ADR-0060): class (iii) — no snapshot var; proposed: partner.financial_distress (form TBD) — 'red finding in machine-readable form' is itself the pending item. ADR-0067 arms this: partner.financial_distress_red_count >= 1 halts — the machine-readable red form is a partner_dd_finding row at severity='red' (workstream='financial_distress').
evaluable_from_evidence: partner.financial_distress_red_count; partner DD needs a named partner after the S4 shape (Q3 = S5)
